n.a. Current independent citation, omission and hallucination tests or courtroom outcome evaluations were not verified.
Fraud-risk category and prevented-suspected-transaction amount are not guilt, accuracy or a validated causal loss estimate.
1874 is reported VSS station coverage; not a verified count of stations running each facial recognition or analytics module.
Delhi traffic ITMS and railway track ITMS are different named workflows, not duplicate installations.

A national implementation-study abstract reports expert-clinician validation and implementation, but independent numeric error rates were not established in the retrieved text and full manuscript access was blocked. A separate local 4,401-record study's 90% figure is not the existing national system's score.

The dated response supports reported integrated use, not independent safety certification or all October operational details. The programme utilisation study raises privacy and access recommendations, but is not a deployed-CDSS accuracy study.
The reviewed records support assistive translation use, not perfect equivalence or current uniform governance across courts.
n.a. 'Improved speed and accuracy' is an official qualitative claim, not a production benchmark with error distributions.
The October source confirms reported scaled use, not independently audited accuracy or every current operational detail.
Headline aggregate 255; four division values 106+14+122+15 sum to 257. Retained unresolved, not interpreted as system failure.
Headline accuracy and prospective multicentre clinical validity are different claims; keep both reporting periods.
Official full-functionality wording retains exceptions; does not establish every relying entity was ready.
More than fifty tools is a portfolio description, not fifty new dataset rows or independent performance evaluations.
Official integration is documented as a source claim; live access, coverage and decision impact were not independently tested.
n.a. Independent error, bias, accuracy and workload evaluations were not verified; vendor anecdotes are not benchmarks.
n.a. Independent legal-semantic error rates by language, case type and model version were not verified.
Dated Phase-I Hindi/English versus undated 22+ language portal; later expansion may explain the difference but is not verified.
Do not present an older deployment announcement as uninterrupted current challan processing.
UPSC reports six-to-eight-second typical authentication; no independent false-accept/reject or subgroup evaluation was verified.

August 2025 answer says over 95 lakh queries resolved as of 15 July; February 2026 backgrounder says over 93 lakh queries responded to as of December 2025. Lower bounds and different wording are not necessarily a decrease, but definitions and consistency were not reconciled.
